about_the_game:
Play as a mischievous shopping cart that's come to life in Checked Out! Navigate whimsical grocery stores, collect items from hilariously chaotic shopping lists, and race to checkout before the clock runs out. Dodge damage, minimize expenses, and earn stamps to unlock exciting new locations!

Game Features:

  • Chaotic Shopping Adventure: Race against the clock through 6 unique grocery store locations, completing over 40 humorous shopping lists.

  • Strategic Destruction: Balance speed and care as any store damage will come directly from your budget at checkout!

  • Destruction Derby Finale: Finish each location by causing as much mayhem and destruction as possible in an epic final showdown.

  • Cute & Colorful Art: Enjoy vibrant, diorama-style graphics filled with charming locations and amusing scenarios.

  • Comedic Story: Follow unhinged memos from Bob Blahblah, the eccentric CEO of Blahblah’s Corporation, as you mischievously undermine his retail empire.

Playtime:

  • Average completion time: 2 hours

  • Full completion and stamp collection offers extended replayability

Join the rebellion and roll your way to retail reckoning!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (or equivalent)
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent integrated graphics
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any standard sound card
  • Additional Notes: Checked Out runs comfortably on most systems capable of running casual indie games. Lower-spec machines should be capable, though performance may vary.

short_description: Checked Out is a casual action game where you race against the clock as a mischievous shopping cart - collect groceries, dodge damage fees, and wreak comedic havoc in physics-based challenges.
